extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent examiners, patent practitioners (attorneys/agents), and applicants preparing U.S. patent applications
extracted.subtask_description: A listing of MPEP Chapter 600 sections specifying the required parts, form, and content of U.S. provisional and nonprovisional patent applications (specification, claims, drawings, oaths/declarations, ADS, fees, IDS, etc.). Useful as a checklist for preparing or examining applications under USPTO practice.
